mappings.note: Contains the superscription/title ('To the choirmaster...') which is not present in OSMAIN v1-v7. This text precedes the narrative content found in OSMAIN v1.
Contains only the historical introduction ('When Ziphites came...'). The prayer portion of this verse in WLC is split into OSMAIN v3.
Contains the first part of the prayer ('God, save me...') which corresponds to the second half of OSMAIN v1.
Matches OSMAIN v2 ('God, hear my prayer...').
Matches OSMAIN v3 ('For strangers have risen up...', including 'Sela'). Note: WLC includes the musical direction 'Selah' at the end of this verse.
Matches OSMAIN v4 ('Behold, God is my helper...').
Contains the text of OSMAIN v5 but includes a textual variant note '[יָשֹׁוב כ] (יָשִׁיב ק)' which is not in the main OSMAIN text.
Matches OSMAIN v6 ('With a freewill offering...').
Matches OSMAIN v7 ('For he has delivered me...').

extraContent.description: Superscription: 'To the choirmaster with stringed instruments; a maskil of David.' (לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד)
Textual variant note: '[יָשֹׁוב כ] (יָשִׁיב ק)' indicating a difference between manuscripts.
